"""CSV export utilities."""

import csv
import io
from collections.abc import Mapping, Iterable

def export_csv(rows, columns):
    """Return an RFC 4180 CSV string for selected columns.

    rows: iterable of mappings. columns: ordered iterable of unique str names.
    """
    column_list = list(columns)
    seen = set()
    for column in column_list:
        if not isinstance(column, str):
            raise ValueError("column names must be strings")
        if column in seen:
            raise ValueError("duplicate column name: %r" % (column,))
        seen.add(column)

    writer = csv.writer(buffer, delimiter=",", quotechar='"', lineterminator="\r\n", quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL, doublequote=True)
